hypothesis: The method signature for toJavaVersionInt was incorrectly defined as returning a float, leading to incorrect return types and potential precision/type mismatch issues during version parsing.
prediction: Changing the return type of the method from float to int will resolve the type mismatch and ensure the method returns the expected integer representation of the Java version.

reasoning_summary: The bug was caused by an incorrect method signature (returning float instead of int). This is a procedural/method-level definition error. It is a correction to the method's computational contract/implementation.
